method: Read-only loopback HTTP checks against a production build. Guide and benchmark structure use Next.js's documented HTML-limited Twitterbot response; an additional ordinary streamed guide response is checked for private artifacts. No conversion requests.

responseStrategy.structuralScope: Completed crawler HTML only; script/RSC text cannot satisfy visible-content checks
responseStrategy.ordinaryScope: HTTP status, content type and full raw-response privacy check

limitations: Does not measure conversion accuracy, public hosting, search ranking or visual browser behavior.
The raw-path check is intended for a production build; development debug payloads are not supported.
Frozen Phase 3.3 publication contract: 7 October 2026 guide, five FAQs and two 4/4 table snapshots dated 6 October 2026 UTC. Future publication changes require an intentional contract review.
